sentences.ar: ركبوا القطار من بومباي، بس فجأة وقف بنص الطريق.
sentences.en: They boarded the train from Bombay, but suddenly it stopped in the middle of the way.

sentences.ar: السكة ما كانت خالصة، فاضطروا يكملوا على ظهر فيل.
sentences.en: The track wasn't finished, so they had to continue on the back of an elephant.

sentences.ar: وهم ماشيين، شافوا ناس كتير حوالين امرأة شابة.
sentences.en: As they were going, they saw many people around a young woman.

sentences.ar: عرفوا إنها أميرة اسمها عودا، وبدهم يأذوها حسب عادة قديمة.
sentences.en: They learned she was a princess named Aouda, and they wanted to harm her according to an old custom.

sentences.ar: قرر فوغ ينقذها، مع إنه هالإشي رح يأخره.
sentences.en: Fogg decided to save her, even though this would delay him.
At night, Passepartout sneaked in and cleverly snatched her away.

sentences.ar: هربوا كلهم سوا قبل ما حدا يصحى.
sentences.en: They all escaped together before anyone woke up.

sentences.ar: عودا صارت معهم بالرحلة، وكانت شاكرة كتير.
sentences.en: Aouda joined them on the journey, and she was very grateful.

sentences.ar: فوغ عاملها باحترام، وقرر ياخدها لمكان أمان.
sentences.en: Fogg treated her with respect and decided to take her to a safe place.
And so they became three instead of two.
